scope: Authored normalized source ledger. Read scopes are positive statements only; no abstract-only/full-body inflation. Full bodies outside packet.

sources.title: Hanke, Homotopy Euler characteristic and the stable free rank of symmetry
sources.version: OWR32/2010, Oberwolfach Reports7(2010)no3; meeting25July2010; official online2March2011
sources.read_scope: Complete contribution: printed1912–1915, physical28–31; physical28 visually inspected.
sources.comparison: Exact original actual-free fixed-space question and simple finite-total-rational-homotopy hypotheses. Large-prime upper bound does not impose equality.

sources.title: Hanke, The stable free rank of symmetry of products of spheres
sources.version: arXiv0803.3572v3 submitted5April2009; v1 submitted25March2008; journalInventMath178(2009)265–298; DOI10.1007/s00222-009-0197-3
sources.read_scope: Actual pp1–4 and referencesp30; additional proof pages27–29 displayed incidentally, not a full proof audit.
sources.comparison: Theorems1.3–1.4 sharp product-of-spheres bounds. Exotic-action nonextension discussion does not compare maximal free ranks. JournalVOR not checked line by line.
sources.version_caution: Current PDF footer18September2021 differs from arXivv3 submission timestamp; not a new submission.

sources.title: Mundet i Riera, Discrete Degree of Symmetry of Manifolds
sources.read_scope: Actual PDF pp6,33–36 and selected references; official HTML introduction/definitions/Theorems1.2–1.15. Full proof of every other theorem not audited.
sources.comparison: Theorem1.11/§13 CWY self-covers of every odd degree imply actual free cyclic actions. Nonabelian pi1 excludes exact Hanke hypotheses; not merely effective-only.

sources.title: Mundet i Riera, Finite abelian group actions on weakly Lefschetz cohomologically symplectic manifolds
sources.version: arXiv2507.22525v1 initial30July2025; v3 submitted31July2026 09:06:43UTC (body date3August2026); journalJTopol19(3)(2026) DOI10.1112/topo.70095 online8September2026
sources.read_scope: Actual pp1–5 definitions/Theorems1.2,1.5,1.6/Corollary1.3 and p48 references; full technical proofs not read.
sources.comparison: WLS top-degree spanning hypothesis fails for5dimensional W with H1=H2=0. Does not apply to this witness; do not generalize special-class comparisons.

sources.title: Hanke, Rational and tame homotopy theory and the toral rank conjecture, corrected workshop notes
sources.version: Hosted under BIRS2022event22w5088; retrieved16October2026; precise file revision date uncertified
sources.read_scope: Actual pp1,10–13, including Remark6.5 and Theorems9.1–9.2. Other pages not fully read.
sources.comparison: Simple elliptic torus bound and large-prime product-homotopy-type bound; neither states required strict-gap witness.

sources.title: Hanke, Publisher's erratum
sources.comparison: Dropped sentence on journalp266 repaired, including Halperin attribution. No theorem correction or gap result.

sources.title: Cappell–Weinberger–Yan, Compact Aspherical Manifolds Whose Fundamental Groups Have Nontrivial Center (v1 title)
sources.read_scope: Actual pp1–5, introduction and construction Steps1–2.
sources.comparison: Early no-circle examples. Dimension statement changed in later version; usev3 for final exclusion and theorem locators.

sources.title: Daura Serrano, Large and iterated finite group actions on manifolds admitting non-zero degree maps to nilmanifolds
sources.version: arXiv2506.11174v1 submitted12June2025 09:07:47UTC; no later arXiv version listed at retrieval
sources.read_scope: Actual pp1–5 introduction/Definitions1.4,1.12/Theorem1.10/Proposition1.11; pp21–22 Lemma3.9 and proofs.
sources.comparison: Almost-free rank versus free prime-rank, special aspherical homogeneous equality and nonzero-degree nilmanifold comparisons. Wu has no nonzero-degree map to same-dimensional positive nilmanifold.

sources.title: Yamaguchi, Rational toral rank of a map
sources.comparison: Rational toral rank permits another space in the rational homotopy type and finite isotropy; not the fixed-space free invariant.

sources.title: Zoller, The Toral Rank Conjecture
sources.version: Notes for Copenhagen24–28June2024; live workshop file retrieved16October2026; exact revision date uncertified
sources.read_scope: Actual pp1–3 definitions/Conjecture1.3/Theorem2.5 and p10 references; remaining pages not fully read.
sources.comparison: Almost-free rational-cohomology conjecture is distinct from equality of free finite and continuous ranks; being open there is no certificate for Hanke's question.

sources.title: Cappell–Weinberger–Yan, Closed Aspherical Manifolds with Center
sources.read_scope: Actual pp2–3,5–6,8–9: theorem/construction and Step4 pi1 computation. Surgery proofs not fully independently verified.
sources.comparison: Nontrivial centerless pi1(V) subgroup and pi1(T(h))=pi1(V) semidirect Z make examples nonabelian, even without optional hyperbolic factor.

sources.title: Mundet i Riera, Topological rigidity of tori and finite group actions (original title)
sources.read_scope: Actual p7 Theorem1.14; pp35–37 §15 proof and p40 references. Additional keyword-hit pages not a complete reading.
sources.comparison: All-odd regular self-cover result already in first posted version. Credits older degree3/powers result. Use version-specific numbering.

sources.title: Daura Serrano, Large and iterated finite group actions on aspherical manifolds
sources.version: Institutional landing publication11July2025;203physical pages; exact retrieved bitstream pinned
sources.read_scope: Cover/abstracts/contents; actual printed12 questions,30–31 Definition1.1.56/Conjecture1.1.57/Theorem1.1.58; printed189 bibliography. Full-text keyword scans for stable-rank/Wu/SU3/SO3/Hanke/Cappell are discovery only.
sources.comparison: Stable-rank is actual free prime-rank for arbitrarily high primes; rank(M) uses almost free tori. Inspected body supplies no exact simple-space gap. Whole thesis not read.

sources.title: Mundet i Riera, Actions of large finite groups on manifolds
sources.read_scope: Actual pp3–6 and12–13 §6, Theorems6.1–6.4/Question6.5; other theorem proofs not fully audited.
sources.comparison: Separates free discrete/stable symmetry and credits Hanke's product theorem; general bounds and maximal-rank rigidity do not assert required strict-gap example.

sources.title: Hausmann, Group Actions and Chromatic Homotopy Theory
sources.read_scope: Official full HTML introduction/§2 through Remark2.10; actual PDF p6 containing same rank-context discussion, plus incidental reference hits.
sources.comparison: Recent Smith/chromatic and product-rank context. Related rank-conjecture advances do not by themselves settle exact Hanke gap; no claim of exhaustive survey reading.

sources.title: van Limbeek, Symmetry gaps in Riemannian geometry and minimal orbifolds
sources.version: Author-hosted manuscript; journalJDG105(2017)487–517; arXiv1405.2291 initial9May2014; retrieved author version not asserted identical to VOR
sources.comparison: Records regular self-cover degree3 and iterates with no circle; infinitely many powers of one prime do not supply infinitely many distinct primes.
